name: DSH2Forsion
description: 在 Forsion 里运行 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：DSH 的界面放进一个 Space，DSH 插件的工具交给 Tangu。兼容 DeepSeek Harness，非 DeepSeek 官方出品。
descriptionEn: Run DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins in Forsion: the DSH interface lives in its own Space and the tools of DSH plugins are offered to Tangu. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness; not made or endorsed by DeepSeek.

onboarding.intro: 第一次打开 DSH Space 时要下载运行时（约 1.1 GB 磁盘），之后插件在 DSH Space 或本页安装。

steps.title: 打开 DSH Space
steps.description: 左侧 Ribbon 出现「DSH」。第一次打开会说明要下载什么、从哪里下载，你点了才开始。

steps.title: 装插件
steps.description: 在本页输入 npm 包名安装：先在临时副本里试装、试启动，通过了才装进来。也可以在 DSH Space 的「插件」页里浏览。

steps.title: 在 Tangu 里用
steps.description: DSH 插件的工具以 dsh__ 开头出现在 Tangu 的工具表里，每次调用都会先问你。

en.intro: The first time you open the DSH Space it downloads the runtime (about 1.1 GB of disk). After that, install plugins from the DSH Space or from this page.

steps.title: Open the DSH Space
steps.description: DSH appears on the left Ribbon. The first time you open it, it explains what it will download and from where, and starts only when you click.

steps.title: Install plugins
steps.description: Enter an npm package name on this page. It is installed and started in a scratch copy first, and added only if that works. You can also browse the Plugins page in the DSH Space.

steps.title: Use them in Tangu
steps.description: Tools from DSH plugins appear in Tangu with names starting with dsh__. Tangu asks you before every call.
